Name: Inpatient Consultation
Description: Encounter for capturing inpatient consultation form observations

Name: Outpatient Consultation
Description: Encounter for capturing outpatient consultation form observations

Name: Contact
Description: Encounter for capturing contact / encounter record form observations

Name: Discharge Summary
Description: Encounter for capturing inpatient discharge summary form observations (not an ADT discharge)

Name: Inpatient Follow-up
Description: Encounter for capturing inpatient follow-up note observations (filled several times per stay)

Name: IPD Monitoring
Description: Encounter for one round of inpatient monitoring chart observations (vitals, Glasgow, fluid balance and nutrition)

Name: Childbirth Record
Description: Encounter for capturing the childbirth record (Dossier d'accouchement) form observations

Name: Partograph Reading
Description: Encounter for one partograph reading during labour (fetal heart rate, dilatation, contractions, maternal vitals)

Name: Pre-operative Record
Description: Encounter for capturing pre-operative record form observations (pre-anaesthesia assessment)

Name: Anaesthesia Report
Description: Encounter for capturing anaesthesia report form observations (operating theatre)

Name: Maternity Consultation
Description: Encounter for capturing the maternity consultation on arrival before delivery (forms Release 1 F13)

Name: Delivery Registration
Description: Encounter for registering the delivery and the newborn(s) at delivery (forms Release 1 F14)

Name: Gynaecology Ultrasound
Description: Encounter for capturing a gynaecology / obstetric ultrasound examination (forms Release 1 F15)

Name: ANC Consultation
Description: Encounter for capturing an antenatal care (CPN) consultation (forms Release 1 F16)

Name: 24-Hour Surveillance
Description: Encounter for the postpartum monitoring of the mother and newborn(s), one per time point from 30 minutes to 24 hours (forms Release 1.1 F17)
